$schema_note: EP-23 roster retirements (owner service-line ruling session, 2026-08-13). The EP-8 mapping left 11 units flagged needs_owner_ruling; after a targeted OSINT sweep (multi-agent web hunt + owner hand-searches of bot-blocked sources) the owner ruled every one. Six units were RETIRED from the modeled roster and are archived here VERBATIM, provenance intact, per the EP-1 archive pattern (archived, not deleted; compiler never reads this file; absence pinned by test ep23_retired_units_are_absent). Retirement reasons ride on each entry's archive_note. Their service_lines.json assignments and the contested Rhoads level-10 topology edge are archived alongside (same-commit rule: a stale assignment trips the no-stale-warnings pin). Reversal is a copy-paste back plus re-pinning the count tests.
